postman.com.company_overview: Postman is an API platform for building and using APIs. Postman simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration so that you can create better APIs—faster.
postman.com.target_audience: Developers, teams, and enterprises building and managing APIs.

supabase.com.company_overview: Supabase is an open-source Firebase alternative that provides a fully managed Postgres backend with authentication, storage, and real-time features. It enables developers and innovation teams to build production-ready applications quickly.
supabase.com.target_audience: Enterprise innovation teams, AI builders, and developers building production-ready applications.

vapi.ai.company_overview: Vapi offers usage‑based and enterprise pricing for voice AI services, including call minutes, concurrency, and optional compliance add‑ons such as HIPAA and zero data retention. The platform provides volume‑based pricing, fixed platform fees, and support options for scaling to enterprise needs.
